dataset_policy: MS COCO recommended for production; this page demonstrates the corrected algorithm with real image tiles from the existing public Imagenette-derived tile sheet until COCO is downloaded in the build pipeline.
object_fill: object area filled only with image tiles, not flat colors
null_fill: NULL/background area filled with light/white-dominant image tiles, not empty color blocks
selection: post-processed target mask separates object/background; tile candidates are separated by brightness/saturation
